definitions.full: H8162. shaatnez שַׁעַטְנֵז noun masculine mixed stuff (perhaps of Egyptian origin; Kn derives from Coptic saht, woven, + nudj, false (Peyron Lex 224. 133 ), and thinks originally שַׁעַטְנֹז ; ᵐ5 has κίβδηλος spurious ); — a kind of cloth forbidden for garments; defined Deut 22:11 by יַחְדָּו וּפִשְׁתִּים צֶמֶר , and Lev 19:19 (H) by כִּלְאַיִם . שֵׁעִיר see שֵׂעִיר . I. שׁעל (√of following; Late Hebrew שַׁעַל , deep, depth , of sea; Aramaic שָׁעֳלָא שְׁעוֺלָא, , = Biblical Hebrew [ שֹׁעַל ]).
